note: Lean proves the direct bound by induction through the abstract `Supply`/`Meets` bookkeeping and the error bound by a separate induction (`nShot_rate`, `chain`), taking any gap `γ` below all `forfeit` values; the minimum is taken in `admit_nesting` (`Finite.exists_min`). The no-proper-internal-vertex coincidence is `empty_gain`.

lemma tariff (t:Tree) (u:ℝ)(a:t.Inner→ℝ)(z:Envelope L t)(v:t.Leaf→S.Tag)(hg:Regular l T t u a z):
   let k:= V t u a (wages v); Supply U l T z (t.topAge u a) k (Menu.raw z v) ∧ Meets U R l T z (Tree.center z) (t.topAge u a) k (Menu.raw z v) := by
      induction t generalizing u with
      | bud => let ht:=bud_supply U hT h u v z a
               exact ⟨ht,Supply.achieves U R h hT hg.nonneg (hg.extent hT) hg.vanish ht⟩
      | fork n f ih => let h₁(j:Fin n):= ih j (a (Sum.inl ())) _ _ (childWages j v) (hg.inside j)
                       let ht:=supplies U R hT v hg (fun j=>(h₁ j).1) (fun j=>(h₁ j).2)
                       exact ⟨ht,Supply.achieves U R h hT hg.nonneg (hg.extent hT) hg.vanish ht⟩

proof_context.conclusion: By induction on the tree, the direct coefficient of degree `m` at a regular geometry has rate at most `Tree.cost 0 a (wages v) - m * a root` (`Meets.output`).

lemma echo_sized {n:ℕ}{f:Fin n→Tree}{z:Envelope L (fork n f)}{v:(fork n f).Leaf→S.Tag}
       {D:(fork n f).Inner→ℕ}{a:(fork n f).Inner→ℝ}{κ:ℝ} {m:ℕ}(c:R.channels m) (hu:gapBelow (fork n f) a D γ) (hg:Regular l T (fork n f) κ a z) : echoRate (l:=l) (T:=T) (a:=a) (κ:=κ) (z:=z) (D:=D) U R v c ∧ echoErr (γ:=γ) (l:=l) (T:=T) (a:=a) (κ:=κ) (z:=z) (D:=D) U R v c:=by
     have hv j(p):= nShot_rate U R h hT γ hh (childWages j v) (gapAll_below (hu j)) (hg.inside j) p
     exact ⟨price_nested U R hg v c h hT (fun i u=>(hv i u).1),chain U R h hT hg v c hu hh (fun i u=>(hv i u).1) (fun i u=>(hv i u).2)⟩

proof_context.conclusion: The error between the direct coefficient and the stacked finite iteration `stacked` has rate at most the same rate minus `γ`, for any `γ` with `gapBelow`.

snippet.text: def forfeit (α:(fork n f).Inner→ℝ)(D:(fork n f).Inner→ℕ)(p:(fork n f).Inner):ℝ:= ((D p+1:ℕ):ℝ)*((fork n f).step 0 α p)

proof_context.conclusion: `forfeit a D p = (D p + 1) * step 0 a p` is the per-vertex gain `(D_v+1)(a_v - a_par)`.
